names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 10054, «Анна (Лыкошина), мц.», with the rank word left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after her name: «Мц. Анны (1925)».

feast.note: Her name page lists two other days, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia, and «8 июня (Петерб.)», the synaxis of the Petersburg saints — which is the one hint the source gives of where she belonged. One row per church is the schema, so both are recorded here and she does not render on them.
